manifest.tape_rule: Step k uses the k-th RandomTape.draw(numpy.random.default_rng(seed)), exactly as run_round draws advertiser-round tapes, independent of bids.
manifest.interval_rule: A wins a contested step iff u < lambda. At interval (lo, hi]: u <= lo gives A, u >= hi gives B, otherwise (lo, u] takes B and (u, hi] takes A.
